title: Todo bien pero ….
body:
Todo bien pero la versión para celular deja bastante que desear a nivel visual.
Estaría bueno que modifiquen como se ve el calendario cuando se pone en el modo “mensual” para que no aparezcan los días del mes siguiente.
No solo confunde un poco, sino que visualmente queda todo muy estirado y eso hace que las notas de cada evento se vean acortadas. 
Se ve feo y no es funcional como otros calendarios que si conozco y son más prácticos como el de apple de iPhone. 
De todos modos uso el calendario de google porque más allá de tener iPhone uso todas las herramientas de google y también mis otros dispositivos son de google, porque si, AMO google. 
Y me encantaría que solucionaran este mínimo detalle del calendario porque es el único que encuentro súper incómodo. El resto todo excelente como siempre. 
Espero algún día solucionen esto así puedo aprovechar el calendario en todos mis dispositivos de google y en este también.

title: Es buenísimo, pero necesita mejorar

Sin embargo, google debería cuidar un poco más su apariencia. Al ser todo muy blanco, es difícil para las personas visuales poder encontrar las herramientas e iconos. Además, es una vergüenza que todavia no se pueda cambiar la letra o agregar imágenes. Para esta altura eso ya se debería haber logrado. 
Espero ver actualizaciones en estos aspectos, porque me encanta usar el paquete de Google Drive.

Y por otro lado, una opción donde se le agreguen calendarios o actividades dentro de un sub calendario. ( por ejemplo tengo mi calendario y dentro de él creo una sub categoría de estudios, donde agregó días y actividades, y dentro de esa categoría, otra para agregar los exámenes, u otra para agregar los trabajas de grupo y actividades para los estudios. Y que el calendario me muestre su deseo, solo el calendario estudio dentro de mi calendario y que no esté también el de trabajo o fechas importantes de mi país. body:
Das Programm ist sehr übersichtlich und hat unglaublich viele Features, die ich sehr lieb gewonnen habe. So wie das anzeigen der Kalenderwoche, die verschiedenen Ansichten (Tag, Woche, Monat).

Was mir missfällt ist, dass sich die Endzeit automatisch nach hinten verstellt, wenn ich die Startzeit nach hinten verschiebe. 
Das nervt jedes mal, leider.

Und was ich mir wünsche ist eine sehr viel größere Farbpalette. Ich hätte gern mehr Farben und mehr Farbtöne (Rosa und Lila Töne, mehr Grün und Blautöne, mehrere Rottöne, Schwarz/Weiß für Light/Dark Mode, usw usw)

title: New Forced Event Duration
body: I have always loved google calendar and I rely on it heavily for planning my life. I am someone who doesn’t need an end time for my events because I use the calendar to keep track of medical appointments etc, where I just need the appointment start time. Since the latest update, suddenly all of my current and past historical events for years that I didn’t have an end time for, now have a forced event duration of 60 mins, showing the start and end time. I’m very very upset by this! Most of these events are either shorter or longer than an hour, and hundreds over years are now forced to have 1 hour time blocks, and I often refer to past events to see how long it’s been between appointments. I understand some people like having an event duration, but people like me who love just having a start time need to be accounted for too! You need to provide flexibility and more options to make the calendar cater for a wider population. Please please bring back the option to have no end time for events! Or if this is a glitch in the system, please fix it!

title: Version 26.10.1: good app + how to make it better
body:
BUG: The search-symbol (a magnifying glass) will randomly disappear - it only comes back after the app is restarted

The iPad version makes completed tasks disappear - it should have a line go through them instead, like on the iPhone version, so that you can mark tasks as uncompleted.

PROS:
You can long-press on a time to create an event/task.

The drag-and-drop function makes rescheduling events easy.

Tap on the address of an event and the app will go to Google Maps, which is very useful.

The repeat options are great - for example, you can have it repeat on the third Wednesday of each month, or on the same date.

Display options provide plenty of flexibility: you can choose to see just the day, the week, or the month.

Regular updates to squash bugs and improve the experience.

HOW TO MAKE IT BETTER:
When marking a reminder as “done” it should sync to the iPhone, so that we don’t get a reminder to do something that’s already been done.

Get rid of the “SAVE” button - the app should save automatically, just like other Google apps.

Allow us to add notifications after an event has started, instead of before.

Expand the notification options, so that we can, for example, add a notification 90 minutes before the event.

The icon should show the current day and date, just like Apple’s Calendar app, instead of just saying “31”.

When typing in the search bar, it should show results as you type, without having to type enter.

When creating/editing an event, the “More options” button should be named “repeat options” so that it isn't hidden.

Add the option to add a notification after the event starts - some events go all day and we might want to go there sometime in the middle of the event.

Rename the colours to their normal names: for example, instead of tomato, call it red.

When editing an event to add a notification, show a button to set it at the time of the event - we shouldn’t have to custom-set it to 0 minutes/hours.

Add the duplicate option, which is available for events, to reminders.

Add an undo button for undoing actions like deleting recurring events.

CONCLUSION: A great app, with a little room for improvement - 5 stars.

title: Important feature missing!!!
body:
Just moved over from apple iOS native calendar app, this calendar app is pretty good but is missing a yearly view. Yearly view is useful when planning or checking anything on a yearly scale like holidays, birthdays, rent, work etc. Anything that happens in more than a month’s time it’s much easier to look at the whole thing in one single view. 

Also in monthly view I don’t know why it is scrolled horizontally but scrolling vertically makes more sense as some days from previous and next month’s are visible at the first and last week of the current month, it would be more seamless to scroll up & down and see each month following the other without page breaks. 

Plus this is just something minor but when scrolling, everything except 3 day view snaps to grid and it breaks the continuity of the calendar. In weeks view if I were to, say I am planning a trip or an event over 4 days, if 2 of those days were on next week the whole event would be broken up into 2 “pages”. Of course I can change the start of week day to a day that puts the whole event into the same page but it’s just nicer to scroll around the calendar to adjust the view instead of having to go settings every time.

title: More features needed
body:
Google Calendar is a solid calendar app and perhaps a staple for anyone wanting to organise their events.

However, there are a few essential features needed to make this app more functional.

Firstly, you should have the option to drag and move events to different dates. I’ve had a few situations I needed to do this but you have to manual edit the event date instead.

Secondly, an option to copy dates with a long press. I know there’s a repeat option but there should be easier/more intuitive ways to do this.

Thirdly, more colour options and palettes are needed. The latest redesign is fantastic but I would like to see more colour options such as palettes where you can choose lighter or more pastel colours. The current colours choices can be a bit too saturated. It can be a visual eyesore if you’re a busy person with many events.

title: A couple missing features...
body:
I love all Google products and apps but having recently switched from the Apple iCal to Google Calendar there is a couple things bugging me!! I rely on my calendar to organise my day so these little things can become big annoyances. 

1) When you want to change the duration of en event there is no easy way to do this - you have to click edit and manually change the times - this is frustrating and time consuming on-the-go!!!
- In iCal you can just double tap on the edge of the event and drag to make an event longer or shorter!! This is both intuitive and time saving!!! 

2) In iCal there is a feature to display the drive-time to your event location from either your current location or a location of your choosing. This is such a useful feature as it helps to organise when I should be leaving to make it to my appointments on time!!! It would be amazing if google cal had this feature too.

title: Almost perfect...!
body:
Been using this calendar app for about 5 years or more on phone and PC. It’s great. I like the features, like colour decoding, notifications, repeating events. 

There are a few things I’d like to be able to do, but can’t at the moment:
1) I’d like the option to be able to create notifications for the finish time of events. Currently only notifications for the starting times are possible. I need reminders to pick up my kids *after* the event too. 
2) I’d like to be able to copy an event to a new date. I can set up repeats, but sometimes when I make a new appt, all details stay the same except the date and time. I’d like to be able to copy/duplicate an existing event to a new date/time. Eg when I’m at the physio making a new appt, I don’t need to re-enter everything, I can just say “copy this event” and select a new date/time. Would also be great - if I’m not asking too much - to have the option when adding a location to an event, to select ‘current location’.

Many thanks in advance. I’ll change my rating to 5/5 (perfection) for these cake icings...!!

body: Excellent calendar functionality except serious Timezone problem that caused me to miss aeroplane: The Google Calendar is disastrous. title: Falha no serviço
body:
Olá, equipe de suporte do Google.

Após a última atualização do aplicativo Google Agenda, todos os meus dados/eventos do calendário desapareceram. Eu não excluí esses compromissos e não solicitei nenhuma alteração ou limpeza da minha agenda.

O problema ocorreu após a atualização e preciso que seja verificado se houve algum erro de sincronização, atualização ou falha no armazenamento dos dados da minha conta.

Meus compromissos são importantes e preciso recuperar os eventos que estavam anteriormente registrados no Google Agenda.

Solicito, por favor, que verifiquem diretamente os dados da minha conta e informem:

1. Se os eventos foram realmente excluídos ou se estão apenas indisponíveis devido a um problema de sincronização;
2. Se existe algum registro dos eventos anteriores à atualização;
3. Se é possível restaurar ou recuperar os eventos desaparecidos;
4. Se houve algum problema conhecido relacionado à última atualização do Google Agenda.

Ressalto que não autorizei a exclusão desses dados e gostaria que nenhuma alteração adicional fosse realizada na minha conta até que o caso seja analisado.

Aguardo uma solução para recuperação dos meus dados.

Obrigado.

title: Tem muito a melhorar
body: Falta a função tarefas, que existe na versão  web mas não aqui. Além disso a função Metas não funciona: programa uma meta diária e ela é criada apenas 5 ou 6 vezes na semana, e você não tem como arrumar isso. Não é possível determinar a hora de realização da meta porque “o aplicativo vai encontrar o horário melhor pra você” e aí te coloca na academia na hora em que você deveria estar no trabalho 🙄. Há também a promessa de que o aplicativo vai aprender com você e ajustar os melhores dias e horários. Aí você vai na versão web, arrasta meta por meta para o dia e hora adequado, e a agenda ignora e continua te mandando para a academia no meio do expediente. O resto funciona bem, mas é como qualquer outra agenda. Ou seja, o que foi criado para ser um diferencial, simplesmente não funciona.

title: Problemas na nova agenda
body:
Sou fotógrafo e utilizo a agenda do Google para agendar meus compromissos, como ensaios e eventos a serem realizados.

Acontece que com essa agenda nova agora, já sumiram 3 eventos que eu tinha agendado. Simplesmente sumiu, como se eu mesmo tivesse apagado.

O primeiro deles eu tive um prejuízo, pois simplesmente não lembrava que eu tinha evento naquele dia. Cheguei 30 min atrasado na festa...

Após esse acontecido, cheguei em casa e conferi todos os meus contratos e estavam todos agendados. Achei que fosse erro meu.

Semana passada, eu tinha na cabeça que dia 17/02 eu tinha um aniversário. Mas, novamente, não tinha nada na agenda. Tenho certeza que eu agendei essa festa.

Hoje, mais uma vez, outro evento sumiu. Só consegui ver porque a cliente pediu pra alterar o horário e o evento não estava mais.

Por favor, corrijam isso o mais breve possível. É um erro muito sério que pode prejudicar muito as pessoas.

Trabalho com a agenda do Google tem quase 3 anos e nunca tive problema. Creio que é essa agenda nova...
author: Moisesnasc

- Google Tasks (including the chrome extension shortcut + gmail messages added to tasks) become reminders showed in Keep and in the calendar.
- In the mobile app (iOS), we need a widget to easily check events and add new ones + reminders.
- In Google Keep, reminders should stay in the reminders tab even after the due date, until they are finished. They also could have a red flag or something similar to show they overdue.
Please, keep up with the good work and make these additions so more improvements can be detected/requested later on.

Outro ponto que poderia ser melhorado nele seria, assim como vc coloca como "lembrete concluído", vc poderia ter uma opção de colocar "evento concluído". 
Poderia ter uma janela no WIDGETS, para ter maior acesso na tela bloqueada, ou até mesmo no widget de "sugestões do Siri".
Comparando com o app que vem no iPhone o "lembretes", o Google agenda é muito mais fácil e prático de utilizar, no "lembrete" vc não tem uma projeção dos eventos com o calendário, ou então uma "programação" como tem no Google agenda.
Muito top o app, já recomendei para vários amigos!
Abraços.

 Para fazer essa alteração é necessário entrar no evento e mudar manualmente os detalhes de horarios. 

SUGESTÃO: Na próxima atualização facilitem a troca de horário. Como? Basta a pessoa "segurar" por dois ou três segundos um evento na lista para que este possa ser arrastado para outro horário.

title: OK
body:
É bom, bem básico. Podia ser melhor. Podia virar quando o telefone vira pra orientação paisagem. Não sei pq vc não pode alterar o calendário do qual o evento pertence depois que foi criado. Os eventos não aparecem nas notificações. Adoraria que as cores que escolho no computador fossem mais parecidas com as cores dos calendários do app. E não tem uma versão pra iPad! Ah, qual é?! Como assim?! Mas a sincronia está de parabéns. Amo poder usar junto com o Toodledo!! Que é o app mais perfeito pra organização de tarefas com o método GTD. 

Its ok, basic, but could be better. I don't know why it doesn't turn with the movement of he phone to landscape orientation. And I don't know why I can't alter the calendar once the event is created. Doesn't make sense. Also, I would love to see on the app calendars the same colors I choose on my computer screen. I know they would never be exact but could be closer. Events doesn't show on the Notifications. Add there could be an iPad version! Come on! But syncing is perfect. I love that I can use it with Toodledo, the perfect app for organizing my tasks with the GTD method.

title: Metas duplicadas
body:
Achei bem interessante as metas, mas todas as que adiciono aparecem duplicadas na agenda. Como a minha agenda é cheia de lembretes, as metas que coloquei que foram duplicadas estão fazendo uma poluição visual desnecessária me confundindo demais.

title: Great app with one suggestion
body:
I absolutely love Google Calendar! It has become one of the main tools I use every day to stay organized, productive, and disciplined. The integration with Google Tasks is excellent, and it has really helped me build better daily habits.

I do have one suggestion that would improve the experience on iPhone.

When I mark a task as completed, a confirmation pop-up with an Undo button appears at the bottom of the screen. While I appreciate having the option to undo, the pop-up blocks the area where I need to tap to complete the next task. This interrupts my workflow because I have to wait for the pop-up to disappear or tap it before I can continue.

It would be much smoother if the confirmation appeared at the top of the screen or in another location that doesn’t interfere with the next task. Right now, it’s easy to accidentally tap Undo, which means I have to manually complete the task again.

This is a small usability improvement, but it would make completing multiple tasks much faster and more seamless.

Thank you to the Google Calendar team for creating such a fantastic app. It has genuinely helped me stay disciplined and organized, and I look forward to future updates!

title: No natural language & wrong Calendar names
body:
I have always used Google Calendar but on my mobile & tablet, I use Fantastical as the “skin” in which to view my calendars. I thought I’d try out the Google Calendar app because it has a timeline in Day to up to Week view, which Fantastical lacks. I really like the Google Calendar app’s interface and UX, but coming from Fantastical, the former seriously falls short:

1) No natural language when writing an event: this is also why I dislike using Google Calendar’s web version, and why I only use it to view events (because lack of desktop app...PLEASE MAKE ONE!) I’m surprised that an app from a pioneer like Google would be missing a feature that some other relatively younger companies have been able to implement for years.

2) Some Calendar names do not match to the name that is given by me. For example, I have an “Academics” calendar which shows up as just “Events” in the app. And there’s nothing I can do in the app to change or modify it. I also reinstalled the app to see if this could be fixed—it isn’t.

3) No today’s Date shown on the app badge or app icon. If it’s a calendar app, it should definitely have something to indicate today’s date.

4) app Widget doesn’t show a Monthly calendar view; it only shows events. I’d like to quickly view the Month and see (via coloured dots that correspond to calendars’ chosen colour) the days on which I have events. 

Things I do like:
1) Very customisable but simple-to-add Notifications
2) Very customisable Repeating function
3) As stated before, a timeline in certain views
4) Event Illustrations are smart and really pleasant

For now, the shortcomings outweigh the positives so I will not be using this app.

It’s great to be able to see my calendar on my laptop, cellphone and iPad so easily. Definitely helps me stay on top of my busy schedule and keep track of all my events and tasks.

title: Still crashes after startup......I fixed it
body:
Here's what worked for me: I removed the Google Calendar app from my iPad. I then deleted my Gmail mail account on my iPad device ONLY. Upon completion of the delete process, I powered off/on my iPad and then I added the Gmail mail account back. Then I re-installed the Google Calendar app, configured it and it now works fine. 

Despite two recent updates promising fixes, my iPad model 1458, software 10.3.3, continues to have this app crash after a prolonged startup.

title: Would love if there was a widget
body:

1. Would love it if there was a widget so that I can finally stop using the stock calendar completely.

2. The automatic scheduling for goals is a hit or miss. If I have to reschedule a goal event through the "later" button, it is rarely able to find an open spot for me in the rest of the week for rescheduling. It just says "unable to find a spot", and removes that occurrence. That's frustrating, because I do have a lot of open spots on some other days during the week.

3. It'd be nice if there was an option of scheduling a 1-off goal occurrence manually. For example, say I was able to clear out my day for today, but earlier in the week had to remove a "workout" event because my day was busy. It'd be nice if I can recover that missed day by adding an event today.

Sin embargo, un tema que creo que es básico no funciona. Al ver el detalle de una cita no puedo ver quien me invitó a la cita. 

Tampoco se ve la el día del mes en el icono, siempre aparece 31.

Una mejora, sería poder definir la hora de término de una cita al momento de crearla arrastrando el dedo.
El resto, OK!

title: 新功能‘’目标‘’的创建和执行似乎存在一些问题
body:
作为Google忠实用户，喜欢日历这个应用已经很多年了，再也没有比它更方便更好用的日历了，而且颜色样式方面的审美一直也保持了较高水平。先感谢Google
另外就是目标这个新功能似乎有点问题，一是目标设定的时候会有问题，会创建目标失败；二是目标创建好了之后，之前设定的智能提醒会莫名失效；三是目标执行的时候，一开始似乎很不智能，一周多次的目标会被放在一天之内提醒好几次
希望在今后版本中这些问题可以解决！再也没有比Google日历更好用的day planner 了，加油

title: Excelente app pero me falta algo
body:
Comencé a usar esta app y la app de “Tareas” y son realmente buenas se sincroniza muy bien, pero me falta algo que extraño de los recordatorios de iOS que me gustaría se implementara solamente en el calendario que es poder etiquetar los recordatorios y poder elegir un como para cada recordatorio, me parece necesario ya que lo uso bastante y al tener casa cosa con un color distinto podría optimizar mi dia a día.

Bueno mi idea es: En el calendario se pueda etiquetar los recordatorios al momento de crear de acuerdo a las listas que se tengan creadas en la app “Tareas” y que los con colores se puedan elegir o modificar bien sea o desde cual quiera de las 2 app o desde una sola app. Y si no se tiene instalada la app “Tareas”, entonces permita crear el recordatorio en el calendario y solo elegir el color, o sea que no se pueda etiquetar, ta cual cómo está ahora.
Otra idea es que en el icono del escritorio de la app no aparezca el número “31” si no el número del día que está en curso. 
Son ideas que ayudarían a cumplirme mucho mejor la principal funcionalidad de la app que es la optimización y organización del tiempo.

title: Regular app. Needs location services.
body:
1. It loves going to deep sleep state so you can't rely on it unless you open it at least once a day (sometimes even less, ~18 hours seems to be the sweet spot). It needs location services urgently. When it goes to sleep it stops sending notifications, and if you add an event/reminder on the web, it doesn't show up on the widget. 
2. It doesn't support URL links.
3. Since widget doesn’t show what’s next on the agenda regardless of its date (like the iOS Up Next widget), it’s mostly useless unless you have a super busy life.

title: Hellmodus auf iOS nicht unabhängig vom System einstellbar
body:
Leider ist es auf iPhone und iPad nicht möglich, den Google Kalender unabhängig von den Systemeinstellungen dauerhaft im Hellmodus zu nutzen. Mein iPhone und iPad sind bewusst im Dunkelmodus eingerichtet und das möchte ich auch so beibehalten.
Den Kalender selbst habe ich am Laptop im Hellmodus mit viel Mühe ästhetisch gestaltet. Umso enttäuschender ist es, dass die iOS-App den Systemmodus zwingend übernimmt. Viele andere Apps bieten inzwischen eine eigene Hell-/Dunkelmodus-Einstellung an und auch auf Android ist dies möglich.
Ich würde mir wünschen, dass Google diese Option auch für iPhone und iPad ergänzt. Solange das nicht möglich ist, werde ich leider auf eine andere Kalender-App ausweichen, obwohl ich Google Kalender ansonsten sehr gerne genutzt hätte.

title: Unmöglich zu bestimmtem Datum zu springen
body:
Seit neuestem ist die Benutzeroberfläche verschlimmbessert: das Symbol mit Lupe und dem heutigen Datum erlaubt kein springen zu einem beliebigen Datum! Damit ist es unmöglich, zu einem zukünftigen Datum zu springen um zb einen Termin zu planen. Denn beim erstellen eines neuen Termins kann man nicht sehen ob und wann was frei ist bzw welche Termine kollidieren.
Bitte baut wieder einen Button zim Navigieren und Springen zu einem bestimmten Datum. Das ist eine Grundfunktion eines Kalenders.
Der selbe Button hatte bisher auch die schnellste Möglichkeit den aktuellen Tag innerhalb des Monats sichtbar zu machen. Einfach über das Auswahlfeld. Ich werde num zum Apple Kalender wechseln müssen

body: I’ve been using the Google Calendar for years, so I felt right at home on this iOS version, and had an overall good experience so far. title: Inzwischen brauchbar nur 2 Funktion fehlen
body:
Nun kann man man die Google Kalender App wirklich gut nutzen lediglich 2  Dinge fehlen mir: 
1. Es gibt die 3 Tages-Ansicht und eine Wochen-Ansicht. 5 Tage wären super oder alternativ eine individuelle Tagesanzahl. Denn man hätte bei 5 Tagen die Arbeitswoche gut abgebildet und zudem kann man z.B. an einem Samstag bereits die ersten 3 Tage der nächsten Woche sehen. 
2. Wenn man einen Termin anklickt um ihn zu bearbeiten: Aktuell muss man leider auf den Termin klicken, dann oben auf den Stift klicken und dann noch einmal in das Textfeld um den Titel zu ändern. 
Wenn man dazu stattdessen einfach nur auf den Text tippen könnte, wäre das toll und intuitiv.

body:
Ich nutze den Kalender sehr gerne, da er sehr übersichtlich ist. Bekomme auch immer meine Erinnerungen.
Ich würde mir allerdings wünschen, dass es eine Einstellung gibt die sich merkt wie lange ein Termin dauert. Z.B. wenn ich das Wort Arbeit eingebe, automatisch 8h damit verbunden sind. Nicht immer eine. Oder bei einem anderen Namen 2h wie zum Beispiel bei einem Call. Mit Tags kann man das bestimmt gut verbinden.
Bei den Terminen gibt es unterschiedliche Farben was es schön übersichtlich macht, das wünsche ich mir auch bei den Aufgaben. Ich kann zwar den Bereich auswählen, doch die Farbe ist dann für alle dieselbe.
Zudem ist toll, dass wenn ich eine Aufgabe erledige diese am Computer verschwindet. Diese Einstellung wünsche ich mir auch fürs Handy.

title: Suggestions
body:
Dear Google Calendar Team,

I would like to start by expressing my appreciation for the great work done with Google Calendar—it is an incredibly useful tool that I rely on daily. However, I believe there are a few areas that could be improved to make it even more efficient and user-friendly. I’d like to propose the following enhancements:

1. Attach Google Maps Addresses with Real-Time Traffic Updates
   It would be highly beneficial if we could attach a Google Maps address directly to events and have the calendar monitor traffic conditions in real-time. For instance, before the event begins, the app could provide live updates on the estimated time of arrival (ETA) based on the current traffic situation. Additionally, it could send notifications or warnings if there are issues like road closures, delays, or public transit cancellations (e.g., an underground train is cancelled), allowing users to adjust their travel plans accordingly.

2. Attachments for Photos and Email Links
   Another useful feature would be the ability to attach files such as photos or email links directly to calendar events. For example, if an event involves ongoing email correspondence, it would be very convenient to attach the relevant email thread, providing quick access without needing to search through Gmail.

Overall, these improvements would significantly enhance productivity and make Google Calendar more proactive in helping users stay organized and on time.

Thank you for considering this feedback. I’m looking forward to seeing the app evolve further!

title: Wechsel von IOS schwierig,
body:

Per Se gefällt mir die App und besonders die Darstellung. Da gibt es sicherlich noch mehr Potenzial. Ist aber auch Geschmacksache. 
Wünschenswert wäre das man die vorgefertigten Kalender(falls man sie nicht benötigt z.B. bei Familien) komplett löschen kann. Verbessert meiner Meinung nach die Übersicht, wenn man es clean mag. Des Weiteren wäre ein zusätzlich Task-Reiter sinnvoll oder die Option zwischen Kalender und Task zu wechseln (also auf mobile). Ich habe aktuell 4 verschiedene Task-Kategorien(auch ohne gewähltes Datum) und kann diese nicht auf einen Blick ansehen( außer am Desktop).

title: Unterschätzte Kalender App
body: wow, lange Zeit verschmäht und mit kostenpflichtige Apps (wovon Fantastical und Calendars5 natürlich trotzdem sehr gut sind) den Google Kalender genutzt, so hat die originale App durchaus Charme! Meine Highlights: Aufgaben/Tasks erscheinen im Kalender zur jeweiligen Uhrzeit, nicht erledigte Tasks werden 30 Tage vorgetragen, 3-Tages-Ansicht ist perfekt am iPhone, einfache Bedienung, individuelle Farben die auch synchronisiert werden, schneller Eintrag vom Homescreen aus,… Was mir nicht so gefällt ist die Optik im Dark Mode, das wirkt durch die schwarze Schrift etwas „alt“

title: Falscher Tag & Widget kaputt
body: Wenn eine Kalender App nicht mal das richtige Datum anzeigen kann, dann läuft gewaltig was schief. Was auch nicht geht: Das widget zeigt keine ganztägigen Aufgaben oder Erinnerungen mehr an, diese verschwinden nach ein paar Stunden oder werden überhaupt nicht angezeigt. In der App kann man keine neuen Kalender anlegen. Man kann auch keine vorhandenen Kalender freigeben und mit anderen Personen teilen. Alles schlichtweg nicht möglich in der App - wofür gibt es sie dann, wenn hier nichts funktioniert und ein Großteil der Funktionen und Einstellungen am PC vorgenommen werden müssen? / Update April 2023: der richtige Tag wird jetzt wieder angezeigt, der Rest Funktion immer noch nicht!

title: I have to kill the app every day, it gets “stuck in the past”
body:

I end up not trusting what I see on my calendar anymore, and switched to another app.

title: Nervt seit einem Jahr
body:
Seit einem Jahr funktioniert die Erinnerungsfunktion des Kalenders nicht mehr richtig! 

Und DAS ist wirklich nervig! 

Ich habe alle Tipps ausprobiert, und die App deinstalliert und neu installiert! Und bei jedem Update kann ich das ganze Spielchen von vorne anfangen! 

Wozu habe ich einen Kalender mit Terminerinnerungen, wenn ich sowieso täglich einmal in die Kalender-App muss, damit ich an meine Termine erinnert werde?!? 🤔🙄

Und ich weiß, dass die App mal wunderbar lief! 
Ich hatte drei unterschiedliche Kalender im Googlekalender, und die Terminerinnerungen funktionierten einwandfrei! 😤

Ich stehe echt kurz davor, die App dauerhaft zu deinstallieren! 🤬 Und da können die netten, passenden Terminbildchen auch nichts mehr retten! 

Und ja, es liegt an Euch Google!!!! 
Die Erinnerungen von Outlook (beruflicher Kalender) funktionieren einwandfrei! 

Und ich bin leider nicht die Einzige, die diese Probleme hat!
author: Nele Begus

title: Guter Kalender mit Luft nach oben.....
body:
iPhone 11 u. iPad 2018

Ich benutze diesen Kalender seit ein paar Wochen parallel zu einem anderen Kalender.

Optisch und von der Handhabung her finde ich ihn in Ordnung. Allerdings nervt die fehlende  Möglichkeit bei iOs, einen schon vorhandenen Termin der öfter benutzt wird zu kopieren/duplizieren. 

Beim Mac oder Win Rechner geht es komischer Weise. Selbst die einfache Apple iOs Kalender App erkennt bei der Termineingabe wiederkehrende Termine. Nach der Eingabe der ersten zwei drei Buchstaben bietet die App schon vorhandene Termine zum kopieren an !

Manchmal kommt bei mir der Gedanke auf, dass vielleicht bewusst diese Funktion nicht eingebunden wird. So bleibt dem Nutzer nichts anderes über, als ein kostenpflichtiges Kalender Abo oder einen Kauf zu tätigen um diese nach meinem Wissen fehlende Funktion zu bekommen.

Man findet diese Funktion bei fast allen Kalendern, nur bei Googles iPhone u. iPad Kalender schafft man es anscheinend nicht, so eine überaus nützliche Funktion auch in der iOs App einzubinden.

title: Missing feature: Add shared calendar via Email-invite link directly in the iOS Google Calendar app
body:

1.) Open Gmail app on iOS
2.) Click „Add calendar“ link in an Email that is an invite to edit appointments in a shared calendar
3.) Google Calendar app on iOS

Expected behavior:

4.) You can add the shared calendar directly in the app

Actual behavior:

4.) The iOS default browser opens, where you add the shared calendar
5.) You have to manually switch back to your Google Calendar app

Bitte ändert das doch mal. Ein „Signalton“ der 1sek dauert verschwindet so schnell in der Peripherie der Aufmerksamkeit, dass funktioniert nur bei Menschen die den ganzen Tag ihr Handy am Körper tragen.

Auf dem Handy und in der Webversion wird ein neuer Termin mit entsprechender Uhrzeit erstellt wenn man in der Tagesansicht auf eine freie Stelle klickt, hier auf dem iPad nicht, wieso? Unintuitiv. title: Bester Kalender mit Luft nach oben
body: Übersichtlich, intuitiv bedienbar und zuverlässig, vor allem aber offen für alle Accounts inkl. iCloud. Der original iOS-Kalender bietet ja leider nicht die Möglichkeit, zuverlässig alle Accounts abzubilden und zu verwalten. Leider hat aber auch der Google-Kalender hier Lift nach oben. Änderung des Kalenders, in dem der Termin eingetragen ist, ist z.B. nachträglich nicht möglich. Dafür muss man dann wieder in den iOS-Kalender (hint!). Dafür ist die Location-Identifikation durch automatische Anzeige passender Google Maps-Einträge ein fantastisches Extra, gerade für spätere Navigation zum Termin. Wünschenswert wäre für alle Kalender-Apps eine Option für Telefon-Termine mit Adressbuch-Verbindung, sodass direkt aus dem Kalendereintrag angerufen werden kann – ist ja kein Hexenwerk. Update bitte!

body:

Some of the worst design changes in a while...

title: Great Alternative
body:
This app is much better than the iOS calendar app, but a few things bother me: 

- If I change the start date of a multiple day event, the app automatically changes the end date, assuming the event has a fixed length. Therefore it’s pretty easy to mess up multiple day events. 

- The Holiday calendars should have more regional options, because I just would like to see the public holidays that apply to the state I’m living in. 

- It would be great if the calendar symbol would show the current date, but I guess that’s restricted by iOS.

title: Für mich der beste Kalender...
body:
...denn die eingetragenen Ereignisse werden sehr häufig liebevoll mit einer Grafik unterstützt! So ist bei einem Friseurtermin immer eine Grafik mit Kamm und Schere zu sehen, bei anstehenden Zahnarztbesuchen entsprechend Zahnbürste und -putzbecher. Das sind kleine Details, die ich gern mag! Zudem können Termine farblich "sortiert" bzw. Markiert werden..  Das hilft Studiumstermine von denen der Arbeit oder des Privatlebens zu trennen. Das beste ist aber, dass man mit einem Google-Account einen "Familienkalender" oder einen "Arbeitsgemeinschaftskalender" erstellen und teilen kann. Dadurch können mehrere Personen Eintragungen machen und alle haben Zugriff darauf!

Ich würde mir allerdings wünschen, dass die AppleWatch Unterstützung findet, sodass mir bevorstehende Termine auch auf der Uhr angezeigt werden! Daher ein Stern Abzug... Den gibt's dann nachträglich, wenn die Implementierung erfolgt ist!

If I swipe to the next or to the previous month it’s all loading immediately, but I can never load the current month’s appointments. It’s very frustrating. Please fix it. It wasn’t like this before. title: Ladezeit wie 56k-Modem
body:
Ich benutze seit 2005 Googles Kalender und seit 1 Jahr diese App, aber ich war noch nie so unzufrieden wie jetzt. Ja, sieht schick aus; aber dem neuen Design ist die Funktionalität komplett zum Opfer gefallen. 
Man öffnet die App, und kann dann erst einmal einen Kaffee aufsetzen, bevor man den ersten Termin ändern kann. Im Prinzip kann man zwischen jedem Bearbeitungsschritt einen Kaffee trinken. Termin angucken? Warten. Termin bearbeiten oder löschen? Warten. Löschen bestätigen? Warten. 
Was macht Google in der ganzen Kaffeezeit? Inhalt des iPads runterladen? Das nervt!

Das automatisch Wechselnde nervt.
2. kann man in der App direkt nach Erstellung eines Termines den Speicherort/Kalender nicht mehr ändern, sondern muss GoogleKalender über den Browser öffnen und hier die Einstellungen des Termins bearbeiten. Sehr zeitaufwendig.
3. kann man mehrere Termine nicht in mehreren Kalendern speichern?
- sprich unabhängig von den Kalendern den Termin mit mehreren Personengruppen von einzelnen Kalendern teilen ohne jede Person einzeln einladen zu müssen?
4. warum stimmen die auszuwählenden Farben des Browser-GoogleKalenders nicht mit denen der App überein? Das schafft Frust und Verwirrung.

Das waren nur einige Kritikpunkte, an und für sich trotzdem gute App.

title: Guter Kalender mit ein paar Schwächen

Pros: 
+Farbzuordnung
+Gute Monatsübersicht

Cons: (konstruktiv)
-Bitte ändert, dass in der Monatsübersicht steht: "Geburtstag" sondern direkt der Name der Person. So muss immer erst der Eintrag Geburtstag angeklickt werden und zu sehen um wen es sich handelt.

title: Herrvorragender Kalender in der Cloud
body:
Ich nutze Google Kalender seit Jahren und bin sehr zufrieden. Die Termine zwischen meiner Frau und mir werden perfekt synchronisiert und wir wissen immer, wann wir beide Zeit für gemeinsame Unternehmungen haben.

Leider kann ich in der Smartphone App den Kalender nicht umstellen und daher immer nur Termine für meinen Kalender eintragen. Das sollte auch in der Smartphone App änderbar gemacht werden. Dann könnte ich beispielsweise auch einen Termin in den Kalender meiner Frau eintragen, was oft sehr wichtig wäre.

Alles in allem sind wir jedoch trotz dieses kleinen Mangels beide sehr zufrieden mit Google Kalender.

Auch eine Queransicht wäre schön. Da könnte man dann fast eine Woche darstellen.
Die Termintitel werden stark abgeschnitten in der 3-Tages Übersicht: "Geburtstag vo..." ist nicht so nützlich.
Zu der Farbauswahl wäre auch nützlich, wenn man nur eine Rahmenfarben nehmen könnte, statt die Termine komplett mit der Farbe zu befüllen.

title: Hypocritical & Disrespectful – Bring Back International Women’s Day
body:
Google has spent years marketing itself as a company that champions diversity and inclusion, especially for women. They’ve run initiatives like ‘Women Techmakers’ and proudly advertised their efforts to support women in STEM. Yet, they’ve now erased International Women’s Day from Google Calendar—a move that directly contradicts their supposed values.

Women make up a huge part of Google’s user base and drive significant ad revenue, yet this decision shows blatant disregard not just for female users, but also for their own female employees. And considering Google is already scaling back its diversity programs, this is just another step in the wrong direction.

If Google still wants to claim it supports women, the least it can do is acknowledge a day that recognises half the world’s population. Fix this.

title: Kunne være mere overskuelig.
body:

Hvis man prøver at gå ind i en aftale og ændre kalender er dette ikke længere en option. Hvorfor ???
Som den er nu er jeg nød til at bruge både Apples og Google kalender fordi den ene kan noget den anden kan og omvendt. 
Appples er mere overskuelig og har en bedre bruger overflade men Googles er mere kompatibel med Gmail dog en klodset brugerflade på telefonen. Til gengæld fungere det meget bedre på computeren .

title: Allow for events to start at 15:47 for 5 stars
body:
I install Google calendar on my iPhone 6 about every 3 months hoping they drop the 5 minute increment limitation. All events created on the app can only start at times ending in 0 and 5. I check the feature is missing and remove the app again. 
Also it would be cool if the icon updated like the Apple calendar icon updates with the date. 
I try to install though because the UI is clearer with calendar colors used as backgrounds on events instead of just a thin bar as on the Apple calendar. Also when certain keywords are used in event titles the background image reflects that. For example boxing gloves for boxing and a train for train rides.

title: Top 1, pero casi perfecta.
body: PROS: [1] Intuitiva, se puede cambiar algo ya fijado arrastrándolo tanto su posición en el calendario como su duración. [2] Fácil de usar. [3] Bonita presentación. Puedes cambiar los colores de todo (eventos, tareas, recordatorios). [4] Capacidad de crear infinitos grupos de eventos. [5] Se ven muy bien la vista en modo de agenda, dia, semana y mes. [6] Se sincroniza a la perfección entre mis 3 dispositivos (móvil MiA1, pc Nitro 5, iPad pro 11”). [7] Se puede usar a la vez con Google Keep y Google Task en el pc. [8] Las tareas sí se pueden repetir como con los eventos. [9] Sincronización de cuentas google. [10] Capacidad de compartir un calendario (grupo de eventos) con otras cuentas google sin darle todos los permisos. [11] Sincronización automáticamente con Google classroom. CONTRAS: [1] Los colores personalizados no se conservan para usarse en otros grupos de eventos que hayas creado. [2] Le falta la vista anual en el ipad. [3] Existen pequeños bugs de visión de lo mismo en la plataforma para móvil o tablet. [4] Los grupos de eventos no se pueden ordenar por prioridad para ver unos por encima de otros. [5] Falta la opción de repetir evento cuando lo creas en la tablet. +SUGERENCIAS: [1] Que las tareas y recordatorios también se puedan arrastrar a otros días como ocurre con los eventos, en la tablet. [2] Que se marque el evento al que no se ha ido de alguna manera visible como cuando marcamos que una tarea se ha hecho, así se puede distinguir a qué eventos de un mismo día se ha ido y a cuales no por ejemplo.

title: Great App - but terrible last icon update
body:
It is a storic App with a very well stablished and recognisable icon which made it pretty easy to find at a quick glance.

With the last update they’ve made the icon desing a huge mess plenty with unnecessary colors which bring nothibg but aweful user experience when trying to localize and quickly identify the App on your ios device.

It brings nothing but bad user experience.
It would be much better more small and progressive changes.

What I don’t like avout the icon:
- too many colours which make it difficult to find among other apps with also a variety of colors. Before you had only to look for the nice blue icon with 31.
- the icon has a huge margin around the colourful frame. This makes the effective icon are very small and thus less easy to identify at quick glance. Maybe a 25% of the icon is white margin.

- En la opción de agenda, al tocar el nombre del mes se ve tanto los días del mes como las tareas. body: Una vez creado un evento, no permite arrastrarlo a otra hora o a otro día. Para mí, eso hace que la aplicación resulte muy difícil de utilizar y muy poco práctica. Como me parecía increíble que una opción tan básica e imprescindible no estuviera en el calendario, fui al foro de ayuda de Google y allí confirmé que, en efecto no se puede arrastrar un evento. title: Muy bueno para ser nuevo
body:
En IPHONE 6PLUS

Falta que ponga la fecha en el icono de escritorio.

Muy importante!! Donde seleccionas vista de un día o 3 días debería haber vista mensual y anual full screen. Y a ser posible poder seleccionarlo sin entrar en submenus  para navegar más rápido por todo el año. La vista mensual que tiene es muy pequeña y no aparecen marcados los días con eventos. 

(Otra solución sería ver la vista mes al poner el movil apaisado y poder navegar entre meses) 

(En la vista més cada día debe poner un resumen de todos los eventos del día a no ser que no quepan en el cuadrado) 

(La vista més debe ser en formato del típico calendario de pared ya que visualmente todo el mundo está acostumbrado y es fácil de ver a primera vista todo lo que hay pendiente y los días libres)

Las fotos del mapa SOBRAN y mucho, solo es una foto que no ayuda para nada. (Mucho mejor ver el evento normal en su color y una vez dentro del evento: Que la dirección del evento sea un link que te redirija a la App de Maps

Es muy bonito pero marea un poco tantas fotos y colores, esto es para gente profesional no para niños de 5 años, cuesta  mucho distinguir lo importante para los profesionales a primera vista, que son los eventos con sus colores diferenciados para cada calendario diferente y eso no se ve bien cuando hay una foto)

Muy bien el poder configurar los colores, se podrían añadir más colores a elegir. 

Resumen muy bueno para ser nuevo pero faltan puntos a mejorar! 
Iré poniendo más a medida lo use 

Felicidades por la App. La esperaba hace mucho!!!!

● Buena integración con el resto de apps y servicios de Google. 
● Diseño atractivo. 

Contras:
● Carece de vista de semana (al menos en el 5S) y la de mes no marca los eventos, lo que para mí lo hace bastante inútil. 
● Carece de widget. 

Creo que es preferible configurar el calendario de Google en ajustes y usar el calendario de Apple o cualquier alternativa como Fantastical.

title: SELKEIN JA PARAS
body:
Monipuolisin ja informatiivisesti selkeä luettava. 
Käytän eniten aikataulunäkymää. Ei turhia päiviä eikä aikoja näkyvillä.  Kaikki tarpeellinen näkyy nopeasti tulevissa ja menneissäkin. 

Toivoisin kuitenkin puhelimiinkin (iPhone) mahdollisuutta sen käyttöön myös vaakanäkymässä.  Minulla on yksi vanhempi puhelin kiinni johdolla koko ajan keittiön telkkarissa vain kalenteria varten.  Pystynäyttö on liian pieni, eikä tekstit näy kauempaa.  Tällä hetkellä siinä on toinen kalenteriappi, mutta sillä ei ole muuta käyttöä kuin se.  Pääsisin eroon yhdestä kalenteriohjelmasta.  Kyse on siis vanhemmasta IOS12 -puhelimesta.  Jos tämmöisen parannuksen saisi aikaan, niin sen pitäisi koskea myös vanhempia versioita. 

Toinen asia: Kalenterimuutokset eivät päivity widgetteihin heti, jos ne on tehty esim. puhelimen omassa kalenteriohjelmassa.  Pitää käväistä Googlen kalenterissa. 

Noiden puutteiden vuoksi vain neljä tähteä.

title: Hyvä, mutta vähän epäkäytännöllinen
body: Liikkuminen kuukausi-, aikataulu-, ja päivänäkymien välillä on mielestäni epäselvää. Välillä kuukausinäkymässä painettaessa yksittäistä päivää kalenteri siirtyy päivänäkymään ja välillä taas aikataulunäkymään. Tästä näkymästä ei välillä pääse takaisin kuukausinäkymään muuten kuin sivupalkin kautta. Toivoisin sovellukseen lisää asetuksia oletusasetuksiin liittyen kuten siihen, onko luotavalla tapahtumalla automaattisesti oletuksena hälytys 30min tapahtumaa vai ei. Tuskin kukaan haluaa jokaiseen tapahtumaansa hälytyksiä joten olisi kiva, jos apissa voisi säätää sitä että tarjoaako kalenteri joka tapahtumalle automaatisesti hälytystä vai ei. Lisäksi toivoisin selkeyttä sille, että kuukausinäkymästä päivää painettaessa siirryttäisiin aina päivänäkymään eikä aikataulunäkymään sillä aikataulunäkymä näyttää monen mielestä helposti sekavalta.

title: Problème depuis la mise à jour
body:
Avant la dernière mise à jour, l’application fonctionnait très bien : lorsque je sélectionnais « Planning », puis « Mois », un simple clic sur un jour du mois ouvrait ce jour en mode planning, ce qui était logique, fluide et surtout cohérent avec le mode d’affichage choisi.

Depuis la mise à jour, ce n’est plus le cas. Désormais, quand on clique sur un jour dans la vue mensuelle, l’affichage bascule automatiquement en mode “Journée”, sans laisser le choix à l’utilisateur.
Résultat : on ne peut plus conserver son mode d’affichage préféré, ce qui casse complètement l’expérience utilisateur.

C’est une régression évidente. Un agenda doit s’adapter aux usages de l’utilisateur, pas lui imposer un affichage par défaut.
Merci de corriger ce comportement ou, a minima, de permettre à l’utilisateur de définir le mode d’ouverture par défaut lorsqu’il clique sur une date.

En l’état, cette mise à jour est clairement décevante.

title: Toujours un probleme via le stage manager
body:
Bonjour, En mode stage manager, quand j’essaye de créer un évènement, l’application scroll toujours vers le bas et je ne vois pas ce que j’écris. Ce problème existe depuis que je l’utilise. Pouvez-vous résoudre rapidement ce problème. À croire que je suis le seul à utiliser le mode stage manager.

03/08/24 toujours le même problème, quand on est dans le second écran, quand je rentre les données, ça fait comme si je mettais la souris en position bas tout le temps.

PS : ce n’est pas mon Trackpad, car pour tout le reste ça fonctionne très bien.

Pouvez-vous arranger ce problème assez rapidement car ça en devient contraignant.
author: Nicolas31600

title: Super

Le seul défaut c’est que le choix des couleurs des événements est restreint. Il n’y a qu’une dizaine de couleurs pas forcément à mon goût. Ce serait super si vous élargissiez ce choix.

body:
Pourquoi sur ios les événements datant de plus de deux ans ne sont pas visibles ?

Sur un IPhone XR toujours le même bug depuis des années : à la première ouverture d’un rdv, si je veux modifier les notes , le curseur se repositionne tout seul à la fin du texte malgré ma demande d’écrire ailleurs dans le texte.

title: Jour de semaine et date du jour sur l’icône !!!
body: Le « 31 » reste figé sur l’icône de l’application du Google agenda sur iPhone, donc quand on regarde son téléphone on ne voit pas d’un coup d’œil le jour de la semaine et la date du jour - ce dont on a absolument besoin ! C’est comme avoir une appli de montre/horloge et dont l’icône montrerait toujours minuit… Alors que l’agenda Apple montre dans l’icône le jour de la semaine et la date - ultra basique et ultra efficace, avant même toutes les fonctionnalités mega sophistiquées… Je dois donc garder les 2 appli côte à côte sur mon écran d’iPhone… Hyper déçue. Si vous pouviez corriger ça, ce serait top.

title: J’aimerais des améliorations
body:
1- J’aimerais avoir la possibilité de donner une couleur à des cases jour (en vue de mois) ( par exemple : couleur sur les week-end et les jours fériés pour avoir une meilleur lecture, et les vacances scolaires des enfants)

2- J’aimerais avoir la possibilité de donner plus d’importance visuel à mes rendez vous à une horaire que celle qui sont sur la journée 

3- j’aimerais avoir la possibilité de modifier que quand je regarde en widgets en vue du mois, le mois commence le 1ier du mois comme un calendrier normal et ne voir que le mois en cours pour une meilleur lecture

4- j’aimerais avoir la possibilité en widgets vue du mois, de lire un rond de couleur pour mes rendez vous et les événements … sans perdre la lisibilité du jour en cours (rond bleu), faire peut être un chiffre un peu plus gros pour le jour en cours

Apporter des modifications tout en laissant libre à la personnalisation en fonction des goûts pour que tout le monde y trouve son compte …

title: Super! Mais TRÈS dommage qu’il n’y a plus de “rappel”
body:
Jai essayé énormément d’agendas différents avant de choisir celui-ci. Les différents étiquettes/couleurs et agenda partagé sont très pratiques. 

Et en plus les “rappels” étaient superbes! Je ne me servais pas du tout des “tâches” car pénibles. Une fois la tâche terminée elle reste affichée dans la journée tandis que quand j’avais terminé un rappel, ça disparaissait de l’agenda pour s’afficher en haut de là journée. Du coup ça ne polluait plus toute l’affichage des différents rdv dans la journée.

Donc TRÈS très dommage ce mise à jour qui a fait sauter les “rappels”.

Une possibilité d’un “étiquette” ou genre d’agenda supplémentaire ce serait chouette!

Apparence vieillotte, manque de possibilité de personnalisation, de création de to do list ou d’évènements types.

Calendrier bien fait mais très limite dans les options.

author: Christoaml49

title: Attention à l’usage en local…
body:
Il faut penser à ajouter une fenêtre de demande de synchronisation avec compte Google après une mise à jour sur iPhone car jusqu’à présent j’utilisais l’application en local (sans m’en préoccuper) et je n’ai pas été averti que les données seraient perdues après mise à jour de l’application car elle a synchronisé mon compte Google sans consentement (ce qui peut être sympathique, mais ne tient pas compte de l’usage avant mise à jour). C’est très grave. Pour ma part cela ne fait que quelques mois d’événements perdus, et seulement des dates personnelles. Pour d’autres c’est sans doute des années et des événements pro, etc.
Il faut veiller svp à optimiser cette étape pour éviter de faire de prochains malheureux par ce manquement…

body:

C’est pourtant la base d’une application de productivité!!!!

Les actions disponibles pour l’application Shortcuts sont limitées à de l’affichage (donc impossible d’automatiser l’enregistrement dun fichier ics dans le calendrier…).

Bref, en l’état, utiliser cette appli est moins utile que de passer par l’application Calendrier d’IOS

title: C’est une bonne appli mais…
body:
L’application est bien conçu, facile d’utilisation mais il lui manque juste ces quelques petits détails pour la rendre parfaite : 
- la possibilité d’ajouter dans l’onglet tâche et rappel, la position (adresse de géolocalisation) pour se rendre au rendez-vous quand à programme dans ces 2 onglets. 
- ajout dans l’onglet tâche et rappel d’une minuterie préprogrammé (la veille) pour nous rappeler quand à prévu de faire la tâche ou le rappel quand à prévu pour le lendemain. 
- il faudrait amélioré le logo de l’application qui a mon goût se fait vieux, on voit juste le chiffre « 31 »  c’est à dire qu’il serait top de pouvoir, avoir une animation des jours qui change de jour en jour.

title: Amazing but
body:
Amazing, this app is THE calendar for me an I wouldn’t change it for the world. 

BUT!!!
1/ why have you removed the option to create a reminder when we press long on the app icon from the Home Screen? Reminders IMO work better than tasks, because when you don’t tick them as done, they STAY in the calendar and you can find them and reprogram them! Having to enter the calendar is annoying. Please put it back! :$
2/ there are bugs: sometimes it takes a few seconds for an event to acknowledge the fact it’s been dragged to another time, and you can’t modify it before it does... 
3/ sometimes the function to drag and drop and swipe to the bottom of the screen (to see end of day for example) doesn’t work! A little bug, but a very recent one. 

Lovely developers of this wonderful app: if you fix these it’ll make me sooooo happy! It’s a great app! Thank you :)

title: A quand l icône qui suit les jours et arrête de marquer 31?
body:
Bonjour, 
c’est une application qui mérite bien plus que 2 étoiles, cependant quelques grandes réserves :
1/ à quand une icône qui affiche la date du jour? 
C’est dommage et non aidant pour un calendrier, d’afficher constamment le chiffre 31.
2/Lorsque l’affichage est en mode « mois », il n’est pas possible de réorganiser l’agencement de l’affichage des éléments importants que nous souhaiterions voir sur les 2 seules lignes d’affichage possible, le reste étant « caché » sous l’option « ...more ».
Une priorité dans les taches d’affichage du meme jour pourrait régler ce problème et permettrait de faire ressortir ce qui sort du quotidien ou ce qui est d’une importance accrue, et de le partager sur les autres calendriers, pour les autres personnes.
Merci de la prise en compte . Sinon très utile application (et c’est pour cela que je prend du temps, espérant contribuer à la faire évoluer dans ces directions)
Bien à vous .

title: Superbe app, mais...
body:
Google calendar est une très bonne application, mais quelques fonctionnalités supplémentaires la rendraient parfaite d'après moi  : 

-  l'ajout d'un mode sombre pour ios. Tout ce blanc donne mal aux yeux. 

- comme l'a déjà suggéré un autre utilisateur, une sélection d'horaires plus précise serait la bienvenue (au lieu de simple incréments en multiples de 5) 

- Enfin, l'ajout d'une option "temps de trajet" qui envoie des rappels lorsqu'il est temps de de partir (comme Apple calendar) simplifierait énormément la planification d'événements. Oui, je sais que Google maps propose déjà cette fonctionnalité, mais pouvoir effectuer cela à partir de Calendar lui-même représenterait un gigantesque gain de temps. 

En dehors de ça, je n'ai pas à me plaindre. L'app est superbe et bien supérieure à toutes celles que j'ai utilisées dans le passé.

title: Glisser-déposer pour les actions journée et les rappels
body:
L'application est idéale pour la gestion de mon agenda. 
Cependant, est-il possible de Glisser-déposer les tâches prévues pour la journée entière ainsi que les rappels directement sur un créneau horaire pour un jour donné ?

Le le Glisser-déposer est aujourd'hui seulement possible pour les tâches ayant une heure de début et de fin, mais pas pour les tâches journée entière ou les rappels.

Exemple : en mettant le doigt sur une tâche enregistrée en journée entière (sans heure de début et de fin) je la fais directement glisser sur le créneau horaire que je choisi.

Cela me permettrait de gagner du temps dans la planification de ma journée et évite d'entrer dans le formulaire de saisie de la tâche pour modifier les heures de début et de fin, ce qui est chronophage surtout s'il existe beaucoup de rappels pour une journée. 

Cela permettrai aussi de garder en fond la vue du calendrier et donc les créneaux disponibles (du jour et / ou de la semaine) pour sélectionner le meilleur créneau pour la tâche en question ou le rappel choisi.

Merci par avance.

title: Nouveau design pas terrible.
body:
Tout d'abord J'utilise l'application depuis maintenant 1 ans environ et je la trouve pratique en tout point, il y a toujours quelque améliorations à faire pour la rendre meilleur évidement mais je la trouve vraiment bien faite utile, enfin jusqu'as ce nouveau design quoi.. 

En mode "MOIS" On dirais le tableau Excel d'un enfant en apprentissage, les lignes sont extrêmement fine, le fond est tout blanc, on différencie à peine les jours hors du mois sélectionnée. 

Je préférais l'ancien, et s'il fallait le changer j'aurais aimé qu'on puisse distingué une semaine d'une autre en un clin d'œil grâce à dés couleur de fond proche mais différente, comme contraste entre un gris ou bleu moins clair et plus clair. 
Et d'avoir les jours hors du mois plus contrasté encore. 

Et puis avoir aussi la possibilité de varié entre une présentation et une autre car peut être que ce design va bien à d'autre personne. 

A titre personnel ça me fait mal au yeux chaque fois que j'ouvre l'application. Je commence déjà à chercher une autre appli proposant quelque chose d'identique avec une présentation différente tellement ça m'embête. 

Merci d'ajuster cela s'il vous plaît.

author: Zil75

title: De (trop) gros manques
body:
Comme toutes les applis google elle est fluide et le design est sympa. En revanche, plusieurs gros manques par rapport à la version web :
 - Impossible de modifier l’agenda d’appartenance pour un évènement déjà créé (!!!),
 - Pas de copie, duplication d’événements... Contrairement à la version web,
 - Impossible de choisir une couleur personnalisée pour l’agenda,
 - Impossible de supprimer ou d'ajouter un agenda. Il faut donc passer par la version web pour cela.

Il n'y a également aucune logique dans l'affichage des rappels dans le widgets. Ils apparaissent, disparaissent, ne se mettent à jour que si on a ouvert l'application. Bref pas terrible.

Je reste sur cette application car il y a bien l’affichage des rappels dans l'app, mais c’est bien le seul avantage.
Comme d’hab avec google, c’est bâclé. Malheureusement...

title: Bugs à corriger
body:
EDIT du 21/05 : Mais FAITES QUELQUE CHOSE BON SANG ! L’appli ne s’ouvre même plus depuis mon précédent avis (ci-dessous) ! Elle crashe dès l’ouverture à chaque fois. Impossible de juste lire ce qui est indiqué sur la journée et alors ne parlons pas d’ajouter d’autres éléments puisque c’est impossible. Ras le bol !

- - - - 
J’adore Google Agenda pour sa praticité (agenda pro et perso en une seule vue) et bien d’autres éléments encore, mais les nombreux bugs qui durent depuis plusieurs mois, deviennent vraiment insupportables. L’appli se bloque à chaque ouverture pendant une vingtaine de secondes. Il faut parfois la redémarrer plusieurs fois pour réussir à se déplacer dans l’agenda ou pour pouvoir ajouter un événement. Mais en plus depuis 2 jours, elle crashe toute seule et ce, plusieurs fois de suite. Faites quelque chose SVP 😫

title: À quand copier / coller un événement ?
body:
Bonjour,
Cette application surpasse l'agenda Apple.
En revanche, malgré les versions distribuée, il n'est toujours pas possible de copier / coller un événement sur la version smartphone; c'est fort dommage car c'est une fonctionne élémentaire de base qui devrait être possible.
Merci de penser à cet axe d'amélioration très rapidement, car
Il est fastidieux de recréer un événement déjà existant, juste pour le rajouter à une autre date.
Bonne continuation dans le développement de cette application 😊

title: Enfin l'appli d'agenda de "Google"
body:
J'attendais ce produit depuis plusieurs années et en attendant j'ai trouvé un super agenda payant qui, pour je moment est encore bien mieux que celui de Google dans sa version actuelle. Entre autres il ne donne donne pas une vision globale et compréhensible du mois. Alors en quoi il es mieux que celui-ci d'iPhone ? Encore entre autres, En synchronisation pour ceux qui utilisent des agendas partagés de Google et celui d'un serveur Exchange et voudraient tout avoir sur iPhone. 
Enfin pour info pour ceux qui voudraient la meilleurs appli agenda que j'ai testé sur une douzaine, elle s'appelle Calendar+. Même son icône est une vision colorée du mois en miniature :)

title: Clear, easy and colourful
body:
If your like me and your looking for a clear and easy app then get this. Because not only is is clear and straightforward to use, it has colour coding with a vast range of colours. It has a great colour range on mobile but a resent update means it has an unbelievably vast range on tablets and probably other devices. 

If you’ve got dyslexia or ADHD this is really good as you can change the colours of your events meaning you don’t have to read every individual entry to find something or know what’s coming up, you can just look at the colours you’ve assigned for certain types of event (if you choose to). The app itself is really fun to look and interact with, each app has its own background and the app itself is clear and well presented.
If you’re into organisation then this is great because, like I said, easy and fun to do colour coding. 

Overall 5 stars, this topped my last calendar app by a mile. My only complaint is that the colour update isn’t on phones as well tablets yet, so when I synced my calendar to my phone my events are all default colour because most colours I used on tablet aren’t on the mobile range. 
(You won’t have this problem if your NOT using a calendar synced from your tablet or a device with extra colours)

I hope you update the mobile app soon so my calendar can be colour coded but until then, I can still see my events and that’s all that really matters.

title: ^**urgent**^
body:
Hello, I have a school account that was set up by my school, and everyone has one. Currently, my school allows students to use their phones, and there was a malfunction with our commonly used app. As a result, many people have transitioned to using Google Calendar, but there’s a problem: 

My school account and personal account are linked, which means my school can view my personal schedule alongside my class schedule.

This displays personal events like birthdays and medical appointments that my school doesn’t need to be privy to, especially since many of those appointments are outside of school hours. While it isn’t a major concern for me that my school timetable is visible on my personal account, it is still an issue. 

This situation is not limited to Google Calendar; I also created a random classroom on Google Classroom with friends where we generate humorous homework assignments, and those appear on my school account as well. 

I sincerely hope this receives attention because I can't operate without my school schedule.

The only issue for me is that my plans normally normally span over the months, and I would really prefer to have the option to scroll continuously, vertically, across the weeks in the month view, instead of having to scroll horizontally to change months. Otherwise, the best calendar app for integration of several schedules.

title: It's good but some obvious improvements needed
body:
Pros: 
• fairly intuitive. 
• more colours available than Apple stock calendar
• themed events stand out such as meals, doctors appointments, phone calls etc with respective art work (my adhd brain loves such distinction)
• I love the various viewing options including "schedule"
• integration of tasks and reminders as separate to events
• just the overall structure is the best in overall feel and interface compared to other apps, I find it the most suitable for my neurodivergent brain

Cons: 
• home screen app icon should really display current date not default 31
• wish there was an option to have all colours available within events, not just when choosing default event, same for tasks and reminders. Overall more customisation freedom basically would be great. Also more neutral colour options such as white, grey and/or black. Neurodivergents like me will know what I mean. 
• wish there was an option to hide completed tasks automatically rather than just crossing them out. My brain doesn't feel tasks are "done" if I can still see them and it bugs me
• wish there were more options to drag and drop say all day events into the day for a specific time rather than having to manually open the even and change it from within. In general drag and drop could be smoother also from day to day. 

Overall my fav calendar app I keep coming back to since others don't have the features I like even if they might have one that this app doesn't have, just really wish the above would he implemented and it would be the perfect cal app for me.

There is also no undo function; nor is there any way to change tasks back to reminders so now I have to re do my ENTIRE year calendar. So anyway, here’s some suggestion:
1) allow tasks/events/reminders to be changeable to each other
2) allow more choice for colour coding, I want my different reminders/tasks/events to be different colours, but the options are limited
3) allow events to repeat for longer periods than just 1 year

title: Autistic dream
body:
I’m autistic and thrive on structure and routine. Since Iv down loaded this app it’s completely transformed my life

1. Iv colour coordinated it such as green is work, red is seeing friend etc now when I look at I know exactly what I’m doing and which day just by the colour

2. I can ask the app to look for a free time during the week to do things like cleaning, exercises etc and it will schedule it in for me 

3. I like how when u put the location of where ur going etc it has a picture sometimes of the place ( such as a picture of my hair dressers shop) 

4. The feature of syncing with my partner means we can see what each other is doing and plan things to do on our days off or free time

5. I love how it works on all my gadget from my Apple Watch , phone, I pad etc 

6. I use the Leeds bin app and I’m able to say add to calendar on that app and it automatically adds the dates to google calander 

7. When adding things to do you can customise it so you can say re-occur every week on a Monday or re-occur once a year for example birthdays/Anniversariesor even re-occur two times a week for three months

I actually prefer this over all the other Callander apps out there, Iv even recommended it to work colleagues and Service users when they have seen my Callander 

10/10 for easy to use, visually appealing, being able to use and lots of different technology, being able to sync calendars with other people. My list is endless I 100% recommend this to anyone that wants more efficiency in their life!

title: WARNING DANGEROUS HACKING Delete Google Calendar now!!
body:
I have been having a problem with my Google Calendar being hacked for months. Thought I had solved the problem by deleting the Click Subscribe Calendar that I never subbed to, and changed event settings to not allowed, but it’s come back with a vengeance. Now it has changed my calendar online to Chinese language and I can’t get it back. I can no longer delete the click subscribe calendar either. Basically there is nothing you can do. There is support or no help from Google as you can’t contact them. Or any way of finding out if the hackers can see your data or access all your accounts and change them too. Like YouTube or Google Drives. 

So for now until Google bother to do something delete the Calendar app from your phones and search for a better more secure calendar app. 

Google Calendar may turn out to be dangerous, and am not willing to take the risk after trying for months, and now the shock of hackers permanently changing the language. Yes I did try to change it back to English but it didn’t work. It still leaves the the Chinese language there as well as some English.

Be careful and good luck. Rachael

Feb 10 2018

December 2018

title: GoogleCalendar review
body:
Google Calendar is a fantastic app to gain for many reasons! We all have busy schedules for our daily routines and it’s very difficult to keep organised. However, Google Calendar allows you to mark any dentist appointment, sleepover, or a reminder to shower with great ease. There are many ways to mark your date, and the app isn’t complicated to work at all. Once you tap the + button on the bottom right, it allows you to put down ALL the important information you need for your specific date, such as the time, place, name, notification and date. I can assure all future users of this app that google Calendar will help greatly with all your troubles when it comes to knowing when and what your doing, all day long. 

-Cecilia

title: Good... but it isn’t Timeful...
body:
DRAG TO CHANGE LENGTH OF EVENTS 

Since acquiring Timeful (the best calendar app ever!), Google has gradually been integrating its features into the calendar. 

However, one feature which is absolutely vital to me is being able not only to drag an event around each day/week, but to resize the length of the event too. 

Add this feature and it’ll become far more user friendly. More Timeful, as soon as possible: intuitive interface and algorithms to arrange tasks based on times of highest productivity, and this has potential to be formidable - not just another calendar app (which, besides perfect google integration, it is at the moment).

Sad, because otherwise this app would be great.

title: Google Calendar Update Caused All Daily Itinerary Entries and Tasks to Disappear
body:
After updating the Google Calendar app, all of my daily itinerary entries, notes, tasks, and schedules disappeared or are no longer displaying properly.

Previously, I used the daily schedule view regularly to organise my plans, work, and personal notes, and everything worked fine before the update.

After the update:

* All entries appear to be missing
* Tasks and reminders disappeared
* Daily itinerary notes no longer show
* The new layout is difficult to navigate and use

I have already checked:

* Calendar sync settings
* Permissions
* Account login
* Hidden calendars

but the issue still remains.

Please investigate and fix this issue as soon as possible, as it has seriously affected my daily planning and schedule management.

Thank you.

title: Fancy but not useful
body:
Another beautifully designed app from Google. Nice to have event recognised and shows clip art.

Missing important function such as month view. The app shows a whole month without showing if there're events in days. And it's hard to open that view. 

Fancy animation used throughout but hard to navigate. It's hard to reach the top to close the event. It would be better if iOS navigation gestures are to be included.

Advance functions available on the web interface are missing. It would be good to duplicate event and move events to another calendar.

title: 介面幾好，另建議改善或新增以下功能
body:
1). 新增行事曆時，無得選擇新增到那個行事曆，只會新增到本身的...
例如：我有2個行事曆，一個「私人」，而另一個是「工作」...

當我新增新約會時只會加到「私人」，無任何選擇加去「工作」

2). 建議可以加入Touch ID解鎖

3). 建議可加入到下拉式清單中

4). 另外顯示方面，我覺得好華麗...而且在清單顯示時下拉則可以顯示成個月份的小月曆，呢個非常正。但當我想睇再下面的清單是，那個小月曆就會隱藏番，請問可否在小月曆的右下角，新增「釘子」令我可以一路Scroll下面清單，一路都會顯示小月曆呢？

5).  假設我想Copy以往的標題，用作開設新約會，可以能夠像地址一樣，直接Copy到，而不用拉來拉去選取？甚至可以考慮Copy成個活動，然後直接新約會？

PS: 本人以實例話你知呢個功能有咩方便我。
因工作關係，我每天工作時都會去不同地點、公司工作...
假設我想Copy兩個月前去過的公司，我現在要先找尋那公司名，再Highlight 那間公司名，再選擇今天的約會，貼上名後新增，再返回兩個月前的紀錄，Copy地址多一次，再找回今天於地點再Paste...

title: Great app! Really enjoy using it! But few very basic features are still missing...
body:
I really enjoy using this app! Was waiting for a long time, till google released it for iOS.
But as for me, there are several very basic features that are still missing:
1. You can't send specific notifications... I mean you can create them for yourself, but not send them. Let say you are about to do party. You send your friend an event. You want to notify them 1 day before, so they would remember to prepare. Than notify once more several hours before the event, so they could remember doing something specific, and then 1 hour before, so they wouldn't be late. You can't set notifications for participants. You can actually set 3 different events, but you'll be considered a spammer, as 1 event for 1 party is more then enough.
2. You can't set push notifications on the phone, when using the web version. Lets say you create a new event for your for your whole family for today evening. You're doing it while you're working and using the PC (web version). And you want all of them to be notified by a push, but not an email... You can't. You can't even set a push notification for yourself. You'll need to create it at web, and then edit it on your phone... Too much work for such a simply task, don't you think? 
3. There is no "inbox" box or whatever you call it. So you can't see new invitations. It seems to be very native to see it in app in one place, so you could accept it from an app as you can do it from an email you get. But instead you need to go to the specific date, and there it is waiting for you :)
4. The app doesn't create an event in the native iOS calendar. Not that it must to have, but if you want all the apps, working with calendar to know of the upcoming event' you'll need to workaround with additional synchronizations... Waze for example uses the native iOS calendar to drive you to the event, so you'll need to sync the google calendar with the iOS calendar' (which you may be don't want do to for some reason)...
So considering the above, if your wife making an appointment for you to take the kid to a doctor, instead of her making most of the job setting all the notifications for me she wants and me just accepting it on an app... She'll do her job, then I'll accept it on a PC, while reading an email, and then, I'll find this on an app' and modify the notifications... And not to forget the synchronization, if you want waze to drive you there automatically.
Not too friendly as I see it.
But after all its a great app!

title: Monthly Recurring event on 29th February in case of non leap year.
body:
### Issue Description:-
I recently encountered an issue with the monthly recurring event feature in your calendar app. When creating a monthly recurring event on 29th, the app doesn't handle February correctly, as it only has 28 days or 29 in leap year. App allows to creates an event on 29th February if you are creating an event in Leap year.

### Expected Behavior:-
For monthly recurring events on 29th February in non leap year the app should ask user before creating an event that “You are creating an event for 29th and there will be no event for said date in February in non leap years (since it doesn't have 29th) so the event will get adjusted to the last day of February i.e. 28th or skip the event for those non leap years”.

### Actual Behavior
The app currently doesn't provide a suitable option for handling February 29th event in non leap years, leading to missing the event in non leap years and defeats the purpose of scheduling events and creating reminders.

### Suggested Improvement
Please consider adding a feature to handle month-end dates for recurring events, ensuring that February is correctly accounted for in non leap years for 29th dated event.

Thank you for considering this feedback! I look forward to seeing improvements in future updates.

body:

- l’aggiunta di più colori tra cui scegliere quando si programma un evento
- la possibilità di visualizzare solo alcuni giorni della settimana per chi ha necessità di vedere il calendario solo per alcuni giorni lavorativi

title: Tante cose da sistemare
body:
Nel 2020 é ancora l’unica app ad includere calendario classico e “abitudini” (i cosiddetti ”obiettivi”) che si possono gestire in modo flessibile, per cui ho ricominciato ad usarla. Ma le criticità che aveva quando la usavo sono rimaste, anzi.

1. La grafica è bruttina. Inoltre, ora che c’é la dark mode su iOS, è ancora più brutta: di solito nelle impostazioni delle singole app puoi scegliere se lasciare la dark mode o tornare alla classica. Io lascio sempre la dark mode ma quella di Google non si può vedere: o la migliorate o è meglio lasciare la possibilità.
2. Non si può “delegare” il calendario apple per spostare l’orario degli obiettivi, ma solo degli eventi “normali”.
3. Il widget, per qualche motivo,  mostra solo gli eventi singoli e non gli obiettivi. Non modificabile nelle impostazioni.
4. Quando apro un obiettivo in un giorno qualunque, anziché mostrarmi i cerchi di completamento delle settimane precedenti vedo, per un bug, le settimane successive successive (quindi aprendo gli obiettivi della settimana corrente vedo chiaramente tutto a zero). Per vedere l’andamento della settimana corrente devo tornare indietro ad oltre un mese fa.

AVETE COMPRATO TIMEFUL CHE ERA UN APP PERFETTA, E AVETE SOLO PEGGIORATO LE SUE FEATURE. Modificate o tornerò a non usarlo di nuovo!

L'unico problema, che non so se dipenda dall'aggiornamento o da un down generale, è che si può cambiare l'orario di inizio degli eventi, ma non l'orario di fine, che resta invariato. Per esempio ho una lezione che è stata anticipata e cambiando l'orario di inizio e fine, risulta che comincia prima, ma finisce come al solito.

Potete risolvere? Grazie e buon lavoro!

title: DA MIGLIORARE!
body:
Suggerimenti:
•sui promemoria dovrebbe essere possibile selezionare l’ora della notifica non solo nel giorno del promemoria stesso, ma anche nei giorni precedenti o per lo meno dovrebbe esserci la possibilità di mettere più notifiche per un solo promemoria. Come è possibile fare con gli eventi
•allegare documenti anche da iCloud e One Drive
•dovrebbe essere possibile interagire con il widget di Google Calendar
•aggiungere la possibilità di creare promemoria o eventi con Siri
•se non è possibile far cambiare il giorno sull’icona dell’app, non scriveteci “31”, confonde solamente
•riconoscimento automatico data e ora quando scrivo un evento. Se scrivo “incontrare Joanne domani alle 10”, dovrebbe in automatico riconoscere “domani” e “alle 10”, impostando data e ora dell’evento

Voli
Hotel
Ristoranti
Eventi con biglietto come film o concerti"

Ho addirittura dato la colpa a problemi del telefono che all’efficiente assistenza Apple sono risultati inesistenti: le altre App funzionano perfettamente!
Tutti i miei impegni e scadenze erano accuratamente annotate in quella indispensabile agenda e sono riuscita a non disperarmi grazie al prelievo dati da parte del calendario Apple, che ora utilizzo con grande soddisfazione e comodità.
